```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="cabinet_single_door">
  <!-- Dimensions (metres) -->
  <!-- Cabinet: 0.44(W) x 0.77(H) x 0.40(D) -->
  <!-- Origin: on floor under middle of object (X=0 center width, Y=0 at middle depth, Z=0 floor) -->
  <!-- Coordinate: X across width, Y toward back (front faces -Y), Z up -->

  <!-- Material -->
  <material name="wood">
    <color rgba="0.55 0.40 0.25 1"/>
  </material>

  <!-- Common visual/collision dimensions -->
  <!-- Assumptions:
       - Wall thickness: 0.02 m
       - Back panel thickness: 0.01 m
       - Floor/Top thickness: 0.02 m
       - Door thickness: 0.02 m
       - Hinges: simple cylinders
       - Door hinge axis: vertical edge at left side (door closes toward +Y, opens toward -Y)
  -->

  <!-- World reference for link placement:
       Cabinet box spans:
         X: [-0.22, +0.22]
         Y: [-0.20, +0.20]  (front is -Y, back is +Y)
         Z: [0, +0.77]
  -->

  <!-- Base cabinet structure -->
  <link name="cabinet_base">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="28.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.330833" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.128267" iyz="0" izz="0.330833"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.44 0.40 0.77"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.44 0.40 0.77"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Door -->
  <link name="door_left">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.00 0.22 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="6.0"/>
      <!-- Door box: thickness (X) = 0.02, height (Z)=0.77, depth (Y) = 0.40? But door spans height x width,
           so actual door dimensions are width (X)=0.44, height (Z)=0.77, thickness (Y)=0.02.
           In this link frame, the door is centered at X=0 (middle of cabinet width),
           but hinge is at X=-0.22 edge. Here we place the COM at y=0.22? We'll set door geometry relative to link origin
           where origin is at the hinge line on that vertical edge.
           Link frame: hinge axis at X=-0.22, Y=+0.20? No: hinge on a vertical edge; interpret as side edge along width.
           For outward swing about a vertical axis, hinge axis should be at the left side (X=-0.22), running along Z.
           Door thickness extends along Y (front-back). We'll model door as box with:
             - width along X: 0.02 (thickness)
             - height along Z: 0.77
             - depth along Y: 0.42? Actually cabinet depth is 0.40; door thickness is 0.02 along Y.
           We'll use box size (0.02 X-thickness, 0.40 Y-depth/width, 0.77 Z-height).
           But door should be like a flat panel: its dimensions should be width (X=0.44) x height (Z=0.77) x thickness (Y=0.02).
           We'll instead create door box with X width=0.44, Y thickness=0.02, Z height=0.77 in link frame.
           Therefore hinge axis at X=-0.22 (edge), door extends from X=-0.22 to X=+0.22, thickness in Y.
      -->
      <!-- For door box in link frame:
           sizeX=0.44, sizeY=0.02, sizeZ=0.77
           COM is at x=0 (center), y=0.01 (center thickness), z=0.385
           But link origin is at hinge line at x=-0.22, y=0.20 (back plane), z=0.
           Thus link-frame COM becomes:
             x = -0.22 + 0.22 = 0
             y = 0.20 - (0.01)?? For hinge on back edge: closed door would be flush with cabinet side? We'll attach door so its inner face sits at back? 
           To keep consistent, we set door link origin at hinge axis located at the cabinet left side edge in X,
           and at cabinet back face in Y (+0.20). Door thickness extends toward front (-Y) when open.
           Therefore when closed, door thickness center is at y = +0.20 - 0.01. In link coordinates where hinge origin is y=0 at +0.20,
           COM y = -0.01.
      -->
      <inertia ixx="0.013053" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.11808" iyz="0" izz="0.11808"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0  -0.01 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.44 0.02 0.77"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.01 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.44 0.02 0.77"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Hinges (simple geometry links attached to cabinet) -->
  <link name="hinge_left_upper">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="0.2"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.000333" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.000333" iyz="0" izz="0.00005"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.22 0.19 0.62" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <cylinder radius="0.01" length="0.04"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.22 0.19 0.62" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <cylinder radius="0.01" length="0.04"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="hinge_left_lower">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="0.2"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.000333" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.000333" iyz="0" izz="0.00005"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.22 0.19 0.14" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <cylinder radius="0.01" length="0.04"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.22 0.19 0.14" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <cylinder radius="0.01" length="0.04"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Fixed joints for hinges -->
  <joint name="fixed_hinge_upper_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="cabinet_base"/>
    <child link="hinge_left_upper"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="fixed_hinge_lower_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="cabinet_base"/>
    <child link="hinge_left_lower"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Door joint: hinge axis vertical (Z). Hinge located at X=-0.22 (left edge), Y=+0.20 (back face), Z=0 -->
  <joint name="door_hinge_left" type="revolute">
    <parent link="cabinet_base"/>
    <child link="door_left"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.22 0.20 0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 0 1"/>
    <limit lower="-1.5708" upper="0.0" effort="30" velocity="2.0"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.2" friction="0.05"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Optional: prevent door from intersecting by using a second (fixed) frame alignment not needed -->

</robot>
```
